propositions: Twelve below-seam ambient config reads in the reconciler JIRA adapter/credential surface are flagged as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS and must be migrated through owned config.py resolvers (11 reads) or marked with read-via comment (1 read).

Eleven composed-config reads (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT, _acli_call_timeout, resolve_comment_max_chars, resolve_jira_datacenter_settings, cutover_clients, _pandoc_timeout) must be routed through new owned resolvers in the composition root to move the ambient reads into the seam.
One read (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE in outbound_fields.py) is owned-in-place via # read-via: marker; the module-local _rebar_env shim must be inlined to os.environ.get and deleted.
The secret credential reads JIRA_API_TOKEN and JIRA_PAT remain unchanged as owner=credential, owned; only non-secret trio and knob reads require cutover.

The cutover must preserve live-per-call precedence (env over file), fail-loud behavior for insecure URLs and malformed config, timeout clamping, and ImportError→default degradation in stdlib-only subprocess context.
All 12 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed and check_config_ownership.py must pass with zero path-glob exceptions; held-out oracle test confirms marker-total==1 and per-file placement.
